access_requests_decision_shape.name: access_requests_decision_shape
access_requests_decision_shape.value:
("access_requests"."state" = 'pending' AND "access_requests"."decided_by" IS NULL AND "access_requests"."decided_at" IS NULL AND "access_requests"."decision_comment" IS NULL)
       OR ("access_requests"."state" <> 'pending' AND "access_requests"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

business_role_grants_kind_matches_refere.name: business_role_grants_kind_matches_reference
business_role_grants_kind_matches_refere.value:
("business_role_grants"."kind" = 'group_membership' AND "business_role_grants"."group_id" IS NOT NULL AND "business_role_grants"."target" IS NULL)
       OR ("business_role_grants"."kind" = 'target_account'   AND "business_role_grants"."target"  IS NOT NULL AND "business_role_grants"."group_id" IS NULL)

recert_items_kind_matches_shape.name: recert_items_kind_matches_shape
recert_items_kind_matches_shape.value:
("recert_items"."item_kind" = 'role_formula'      AND "recert_items"."subject_user_id" IS NULL     AND "recert_items"."member_count" IS NOT NULL AND "recert_items"."exception_reason" IS NULL)
       OR ("recert_items"."item_kind" = 'include_exception' AND "recert_items"."subject_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "recert_items"."exception_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "recert_items"."member_count" IS NULL)
